questions.question: Which gas is a product of aerobic respiration?

answerOptions.rationale: Glucose is broken down to carbon dioxide and water.

questions.hint: Think about what you breathe out.

questions.question: Which of these are products of anaerobic respiration in yeast?

answerOptions.rationale: Lactic acid is made in muscles.

questions.hint: There is more than one correct answer.

questions.question: After vigorous exercise, the extra oxygen needed to break down lactic acid is called the ____.
questions.rationale: Lactic acid is broken down using oxygen after exercise.

questions.question: Explain why aerobic respiration releases more energy than anaerobic respiration.

grading.modelAnswer: Glucose is completely broken down to carbon dioxide and water, releasing more energy.

questions.hint: Compare how completely glucose is broken down.
